summary: Cardiol Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K attaching its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements, MD&A and CEO/CFO certifications (Canadian Form 52-109F2 equivalent to SOX 302 certifications) for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. This is a routine periodic reporting filing by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. Balance sheet shows cash of C$29.2M at September 30, 2026 versus C$21.4M at year-end 2025, total equity C$27.6M, deficit C$243.3M, and a nine-month net loss of C$30.2M (C$0.27 per share). No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is presented. What to watch: cash runway and any subsequent financings disclosed in the notes.
